subject: SIG: Air-gapped / On-prem addendum — evidence delivery & support playbook
messages:
From: Claire Hughes <claire.hughes@acme.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG follow-up — air-gapped deployment addendum and evidence path

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our procurement and security review we'd like a short SIG addendum describing how Redwood supports air-gapped/on-prem customers: specifically offline update mechanics, artifact delivery, verification (checksums/signatures), and the support model for incident response when systems are not internet-connected.

High-level asks:
- Delivery options (sneakernet / courier USB, signed ISO, pre-authorized jumpbox transfer)
- Artifact format, signing & checksum approach we can include in our control evidence
- How patches/critical updates are communicated and delivered (cadence + emergency patches)
- Operational support expectations — remote vs on-site, escalation windows, and any SLA exceptions for air-gapped installs

Target timeline: we need the addendum and an evidence bundle (manifest + sample signed artifact) by next Tuesday 2026-07-21 for our review cycle. Is that feasible?

Also copying our procurement lead (Dan) for contract/pricing questions.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Hughes
Security Program Manager
Acme Robotics
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hughes <claire.hughes@acme.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — air-gapped deployment addendum and evidence path

Claire — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely produce a focused SIG addendum and a small evidence bundle that demonstrates our delivery & verification process. I sketched a short playbook and attached an initial draft addendum (SIG_Airgapped_Addendum_v1_draft.pdf). Key notes:

- Delivery options: we support signed artifacts via courier (USB or encrypted disk), pre-signed manifest + checksums, and controlled jumpbox transfers when customers provide a bastion host.
- Signing: all delivered binaries are signed with Redwood's code-signing key (PKI) and accompanied by SHA-256 checksums. We include a signed manifest file with the build metadata and checksum list.
- Updates: default cadence is quarterly noncritical updates; critical/security patches have a documented emergency delivery path (courier or encrypted air-gapped transfer with out-of-band verification).
- Support: we offer remote troubleshooting by default and on-site engagements under a paid SOW. For air-gapped customers we provide an optional annual or per-incident on-site SLA (response time negotiated).

Open questions for you:
1) Does Acme require hardware custody transfer receipts for couriers?
2) Will you provide a bastion/jumpbox and one or more pull windows for scheduled updates?
3) Any corporate restrictions on external media (USB) that would force a specific delivery method?

Next step: Vivek (cc'd) will review technical signing and verification language, and Laura will flag anything we should route through legal/contract language. If these answers look OK we can aim to finalize the addendum and produce a tiny evidence bundle by 2026-07-20.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, Claire Hughes <claire.hughes@acme.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — air-gapped deployment addendum and evidence path

Soojin / Claire — quick technical clarifications to include in the addendum: 

- Artifact packaging: we produce release bundles as TAR.GZ with a signed manifest file (manifest.json.sig). Manifest contains file paths, sizes, SHA-256 checksums, build id, git commit, and signer CN. The .sig is an RSA-4096 PKCS#7 signature (or optionally an XML-based signature for FIPS environments).
- Verification: the on-prem admin runs our verify script which validates the signature and recomputes checksums. We can provide an offline verification binary and a reproducible verification recipe.
- Emergency patches: for critical CVEs we prepare a minimal patch bundle and generate both an online delivery path (for customers with a jumpbox) and an offline package for courier delivery. Each emergency package includes a test harness (unit smoke tests) and instructions for safe rollback.
- Chain of custody: courier deliveries are accompanied by an audit receipt (PDF with courier tracking + recipient sign-off). We can also provide an HSM-signed manifest on request.

I'll add a short subsection on reproducible builds and verification scripts for the addendum. Attaching an internal checklist we use for air-gap releases (internal reference only).

— Vivek
Director of Security Engineering
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hughes <claire.hughes@acme.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-18T10:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — air-gapped deployment addendum and evidence path

Claire — looping in specifics for pricing and support models so procurement has a single place to review.

Options we can offer (summary):
- Bronze (included): quarterly offline evidence bundles, remote verification support during business hours (email + remote jumpbox guidance). No on-site visits.
- Silver (paid): quarterly + ad-hoc critical patch courier delivery (one physical shipment per year included), phone support, 24h remote response window.
- Gold (paid, enterprise): annual on-site support allocation (two visits), 4h emergency response SLA for security patches (subject to travel windows), dedicated account engineer for air-gapped installs.

I've attached Support_Roles.xlsx (staffing & RACI) and Support_Pricing_Summary.pdf. For courier deliveries we partner with vetted secure couriers; costs can be billed per-shipment or included in a pre-paid credits package.

Please confirm whether Acme prefers shipment-based cost or included annual support credits and we'll surface line items for procurement.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Dan Miller <procurement@acme.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Claire Hughes <claire.hughes@acme.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — air-gapped deployment addendum and evidence path

Monica — thanks for the tiers. A couple procurement Qs: 
1) If we take Silver, can we get a per-shipment cap and an SLA for shipment acknowledgement?
2) For Gold, is the 4h emergency response SLA measured from time of notification or from when on-site access is available? (our campus has restricted visitor processing which can add 12–24h)
3) We need contract language that limits Redwood liability during courier transfers — would you share the proposed clause?

Also, Claire — we have a compliance window the week of 2026-07-26. If Redwood can deliver the signed addendum + sample manifest before 2026-07-21 (as requested) we can include it in our package.

Regards,
Dan Miller
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Robotics

Dan / Claire — final deliverables attached and next steps below. Apologies for the multiple notes, wanted to ensure we captured everything you asked for. Attachments: 
- SIG_Airgapped_Addendum_v1_final.pdf (final addendum language suitable for SIG submission)
- Manifest_checksums.txt (example manifest + checksums + signer metadata)
- Support_Roles.xlsx (staffing & RACI)
- Support_Pricing_Summary.pdf

Summary of commitments: 
- Delivery: evidence bundle + signed manifest delivered to you via secure courier (if you choose that path) or uploaded to your pre-authorized bastion during agreed maintenance window.
- Verification: we provide an offline verifier and step-by-step runbook. We will also perform a joint verification session (remote) the day after delivery to sign off on checksums.
- Emergency patches: Redwood will prepare emergency patch packages within 24h business hours and coordinate courier pickup; measured SLA for on-site Gold customers is from time on-site access is available (we will include a clause for restricted campuses).
- Liability: Laura (cc) will propose the standard limited-liability wording for courier shipments and include an optional addendum for HSM-signed manifests if you require higher assurance.

Next actions: 
1) Claire — confirm preferred delivery method (courier vs bastion) and whether courier receipts are required.
2) Dan — let us know procurement preference (per-shipment billing vs pre-paid credits).
3) Laura & I will draft the contract clause and DocuSign envelope for the SIG addendum (link below).

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/secure-sign/aa12-example
Drive folder (evidence & scripts): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aq_example_drive_link
Jira ticket: JIRA-SUP-1279

Thanks — we will be on standby to finalize once you confirm delivery method.

Best,
